title: Ketamine Treatment Plans for Chronic Conditions
official: Understanding the Safety of Home Ketamine Treatment Plans for Chronic Conditions
summary: A study aimed to assess the efficacy of the various approaches to prescribing Ketamine currently in use off-label. The focus will be to include ketamine within the study plan of those with chronic conditions who are receiving ketamine.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Must have an identifiable chronic condition.

Exclusion Criteria:

Healthy population
